# Exchanges

A standard unused item may be considered for exchange within the 30-day return window. The replacement item is priced at the amount current when the exchange is approved. Any price difference and collection or redelivery charge is confirmed by a manager.

An exchange is not reserved until approval. Made-to-order and personalized items cannot be exchanged for preference reasons. Faulty, damaged, wrong, or incomplete items follow the issue-resolution process instead of the change-of-mind exchange process.
